 Mr. Rishabh Gupta, Advocate,
 for non-applicant/claimant No.2.
 ****
Cm-10287-Cii-2021

Since appellant No.1 is stated to have died during the pendency of the appeal,
therefore, the entire amount of compensation can be paid to appellant No.2 Surinder Kaur, after verifying the death of appellant No.1.
Application is, accordingly, disposed of. CM-2258-CII-2020 For the reasons stated in the application, duly supported by an affidavit, delay of 19 days in filing the review application is condoned.
This is an application filed by respondent No.4 - National Insurance Company seeking review of the order dated 25.09.2019 passed by this Court.

2. The case of the applicant/respondent No.4 is that despite the fact that the deceased was granted reimbursement of the medical expenses by his employer, vide order dated 25.09.2019 passed by this Court, his parents (claimants) were awarded a sum of Rs. 4,50,000/- towards medical expenses.
